svg.title: Forest Service, British Columbia: yellow-sky oval, refined vector redraw
svg.desc: Refined vector redraw following a generated restoration image of the emblem, not a photograph: oval borders, outlined lettering and hand-drawn tree and landscape paths, all vector, transparent outside the emblem.
